messages:
eli: Heads-up: noticed a lot of UI jank in sampleapp when firing ~20 concurrent requests on emulator (Pixel API 31). Looks like OkHttp retries + pooled sockets cause long tail stalls.

eli: Repro steps: open sample feed, scroll to trigger 20 image/meta requests, emulator network slows -> lots of retry logs and 'response body not closed' warnings.

tasha: Can you paste the exact OkHttp client config and a short log snip? Curious if this is emulator-only or real device too.

eli: Client config:
```
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .connectionPool(ConnectionPool(5, 5, TimeUnit.MINUTES))
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .dispatcher(Dispatcher().apply { maxRequests = 64; maxRequestsPerHost = 5 })
  .build()
```
Log excerpt: 
```
W/OkHttp: A connection to http://10.0.2.2/ was leaked. Did you forget to close a response body?
E/Network: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out
I/ConnPool: Releasing connection for route /10.0.2.2
```

samir: Leak warning + timeouts = pooled sockets being reused while emulator drops packets. Two quick experiments: set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) and also try ConnectionPool(0, 1, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) to brute-force disabling pooling.

android-qa: Reproduced on Pixel 5 emulator (API 31). adb logcat shows ConnectionPool evict/re-acquire cycles: 
```
I/OkHttp: ConnectionPool: connection=Socket{addr=/10.0.2.2, id=42} evicted
I/OkHttp: ConnectionPool: shared connection acquired for reuse
E/OkHttp: java.net.SocketTimeoutException: Read timed out
```

tasha: Also try reducing Dispatcher.maxRequestsPerHost to 2 — if concurrency is triggering races, throttling should smooth out jank. If that helps, we should document recommended defaults for emulator.

eli: Tried dispatcher=2: UI smoother but overall throughput drops (obvious). ConnectionPool(0,1ms) removed leak logs but CPU increased and occasional read timeouts persisted. Setting protocols(listOf(Protocol.HTTP_1_1)) (disable HTTP/2) removed most of the partial-frame errors on emulator.

samir: That matches suspicion: emulator's network virtualization + HTTP/2 multiplexing can drop frames; OkHttp tries to reuse the stream and hits timeouts. Short-term fixes:
- expose Dispatcher and ConnectionPool knobs in sampleapp and guide
- use conservative defaults on emulator (maxRequestsPerHost=2, disable HTTP/2)
- implement jittered backoff in SDK retry wrapper so retries don't amplify congestion

devex-bot: Created issue #2042: "emulator: okhttp connection reuse + timeouts under high concurrency" assigned to samir.

joel: For SDK: prefer to keep retryOnConnectionFailure=true in general, but wrap with idempotency checks and exponential+jitter. Also add a special-case in sampleapp startup that detects emulator via ro.build.characteristics and tweaks Dispatcher/ConnectionPool/protocols so new devs have less friction.

eli: I'll open a small PR: update sampleapp to set conservative Dispatcher defaults on emulator, add Troubleshooting section mentioning HTTP/2 workaround, and add a minimal harness that fires concurrent requests for CI repro.

tasha: Nice. Also add a test matrix row comparing HTTP/2 vs HTTP/1.1 on emulator vs physical devices so we don't regress.

eli: Will do. Thanks! :thumbsup:
